_comment: quasar-image — single source of truth. Scripts and SKILL.md read from here; no role, tag, host fact or deploy command is duplicated elsewhere.

dev._role: Build/test env. NEVER deployed as an agent.

deploy._comment: Literal command run on the host by `qimg deploy`, keyed by host NAME as configured in _shared/hosts.json. A host with no entry makes deploy refuse rather than guess.
deploy._empty_on_purpose: SHIPPED EMPTY. Add an entry only for a host YOU named in _shared/hosts.json. This map used to arrive pre-filled with the original operator's own host names, so anyone whose host happened to be called the same thing inherited a force-recreate they never wrote. Example entries, for reference only: 'deploy/build-images.sh runtime --deploy' or 'docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d --force-recreate --wait quasar-node-agent'.
